name: Chain
summary: Utilize: bind a Grappled, Incapacitated or Restrained creature (DC 13 Strength (Athletics)).
text: As a Utilize action, you can wrap the Chain around an unwilling creature within 5 feet of you that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition, if you succeed on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. If its legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it gets free. Slipping out of the Chain takes an action and a successful DC 18 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check; breaking it takes an action and a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.
